_comment: Copy to gitlab.config.json (gitignored). Token needs 'read_api' scope. Get one at https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens. Membership scope means we fetch only projects you're a member of.
_projectScope_comment: membership (default) = your projects only · all = everything you can see · starred = only starred
_maxProjects_comment: How many projects (sorted by latest activity) to scan each refresh. 30 keeps the GraphQL response small.
